ownership_scope: Four solver shapes, up to 1031 variables and a 257-dimensional SOC. Three solvers coexist; every vector starts at exact zero, lies in aligned/disjoint arena space, and retains its unique tag after all views are written. Middle-solver teardown and replacement preserve surviving solver values. Explicit arena capability prevents silent fallback to baseline.
